annotation.title_clean: 14 CFR Part 22—Design, Production, and Airworthiness Requirements for Non-Type Certificated Aircraft
annotation.title_en: 14 CFR Part 22—Design, Production, and Airworthiness Requirements for Non-Type Certificated Aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (US Department of Transportation)
annotation.summary_en: US FAA regulation (14 CFR Part 22, adopted July 2025) setting design, production and airworthiness requirements for light-sport category non-type-certificated aircraft, using FAA-accepted consensus standards. Explicitly excludes unmanned aircraft. Covers eligibility, structural, propulsion, controls, quality assurance, and testing requirements, including simplified flight controls.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to special airworthiness certificates for light-sport non-type-certificated aircraft; excludes unmanned aircraft.
Compliance via FAA-accepted consensus standards, found by trained compliance staff.
Performance-based design requirements: structure, propulsion, fuel, fire protection, evacuation.
Simplified flight controls aircraft must automate flight path and prevent loss of control.
Requires documented quality assurance and ground/flight production acceptance testing.
